reviewer: S10 voice director (Opus), 26 Nov 2026. Reviewed takes generated by another session; no speech generated in this review.
transcript_source: local whisper.cpp /opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli, model ~/.whisper-models/ggml-small.bin, no prompt, no script given. Full take in the line language (-l hi or -l en), plus an -l en pass on Hindi takes. Short segments re-run where a pass dropped words; ggml-base.bin as a third opinion on four segments. The connector transcriber was not used (its text cannot be read back). Whisper small is weak on Hindi: it is a check on words, not proof.
measures: ffmpeg 8.1.1. silencedetect -40 dB, 0.2 s: lead/trail silence and internal pauses. ebur128 integrated LUFS and true peak; volumedetect sample peak and mean. Pure-Python pitch at 8 kHz, 40 ms frames, 20 ms hop, 70-400 Hz: normalised autocorrelation, frames above -45 dBFS counted active, voiced if peak > 0.5 (voiced_ratio = voiced/active; head_voiced_ratio = first 0.6 s, used for laugh and sigh lead-ins); median_f0_hz from voiced frames. YIN (threshold 0.15) as a cross-check; YIN accepted few frames on some takes (11-17), so autocorrelation is the main figure. words_per_s = script words (tags removed) / (speech span - pauses). Phone check for the DSP: 2x highpass 300 Hz, 2x lowpass 3400 Hz, 8 kHz resample, 4:1 compressor, then whisper.

takes.text: [deadpan] मैं इस इलाके की SI हूँ। और ये थाना मेरे record में है ही नहीं।
takes.transcript: मैं इस इलाके की एस आय हूं। और ये ताना मेरे रेकोड में है ही नहीं।
takes.transcript_en_pass: I am the SI of this area. And this police station is not in my record.

takes.text: [quietly] तीस की तीस... मेरे ही थाने से लौटाई हुई हैं। [slowly] तो कल दस बजे से पहले... arrest किसे करूँ?
takes.transcript: तीस की तीस मीरे ही ताने से लोटाए हुई है तो कल दस बजे से पहले अरेस्ट किसे करूं?
takes.transcript_en_pass: 30x30, I have returned from the police station. So, who should I arrest before 10am?

takes.text: [deadpan] I am the SI for this area. And this thana is not in my records at all.
takes.transcript: I am the SI for this area and this Thana is not in my records at all.

takes.text: [curt] Thirty complaints. One name in all thirty: Bhaiyaji.
takes.transcript: 30 Complaints. One name in all 30. Bhaiyaji.

takes.text: [politely] बैठिए madam। पहले चाय, फिर complaint।
takes.transcript: बेखिय मादम पहले चाय फिर कंप्लेंट
takes.transcript_en_pass: Bekhiye madam, pehle chai, fir complaint.
takes.segment_transcripts: 0-0.9 s: small hi 'बेखिया मादम', small en 'Bekhiya madam', base en 'Back here madam'. 'बैठिए' not confirmed.

takes.text: [formally] Arrest आपका हक़ है, madam। पर charge handover के बिना थाना नहीं छोड़ा जाता।
takes.transcript: अरेस्ट आपका हुग है मैंडम पर चार्ज हैंडोवर के भिना ताना नहीं चोडा जाता।
takes.transcript_en_pass: Arrest is your right, ma'am. But you can't leave the police station without a charge handover.

takes.text: [politely] Please sit, madam. First tea, then complaint.
takes.transcript: Please sit, madam. First tea, then complaint.

takes.text: [quietly] The thana is fake, madam. The complaints are real.
takes.transcript: The thana is fake madam. The complaints are real.

takes.text: [lazily] जहाँ complaint नहीं, वहाँ crime नहीं, madam। [relaxed] मूँगफली लीजिए।
takes.transcript: जाहा कंप्लेंट नहीं वाहा क्राईम नहीं मडर्म मुँभली लिजे
takes.transcript_en_pass: Where there is no complaint, there is no crime, madam.

takes.text: [flat] तो इसे अंदर madam ने भेजा। [low] Court में मैं यही बोलूँगा: madam को सब पता था।
takes.transcript: तो इसे अंदर मैडम ने भेजा, कोट में मैं यही बोलूंगा. मैडम को सक पता ता.
takes.transcript_en_pass: So she sent him inside. I will say this in court. Ma'am knew everything.

takes.text: [lazily] No complaint, no crime, madam. Have some peanuts.
takes.transcript: No complaint, no crime, madam. Have some peanuts.

takes.text: [relaxed] Arre madam, chhodiye. Two years, not one FIR. Zero crime. Look at the shield.
takes.transcript: Madam, leave it. Two years, not one FIR. Zero crime. Look at the shield.
takes.segment_transcripts: 0-1.6 s: hi pass 'और मैंडम चोडिये' (= Arre madam, chhodiye); the en pass translated it to 'Madam, leave it'.

takes.text: [warmly] Inspector साहब! इस महीने का।
takes.transcript: इंश्पेक्टर सहाब इस महीने का
takes.transcript_en_pass: Inspector Sahab, this MAHINECA.

takes.text: [laughs softly] नक़ली Inspector! [warmly] आइए... आप ही का तो इंतज़ार था।
takes.transcript: अब ही का तो इंटिजार ता
takes.transcript_en_pass: The clean inspector. Come. I was waiting for you.
takes.segment_transcripts: 0-1.05 s: whisper en '(laughs)'. 1.05-2.9 s: en 'the clean inspector.', hi pass garbled; the Hindi full pass drops 'नक़ली Inspector! आइए'.

takes.text: [warmly] Inspector sahab! This month's.
takes.transcript: Inspect us this month.

takes.text: [chuckles] Fake Inspector! Aaiye... it was you we were waiting for.
takes.transcript: Fake Inspector! Aya! It was you we were waiting for!

takes.text: [dry] SHO साहब जिसे लौटाते थे, उसे line के पार मैं भेजती थी, madam।
takes.transcript: सहो सहाब जिसे लोटाते ते उसे लाईन के पार मैं बहिषती ती मैंडम
takes.transcript_en_pass: I used to send her to the line of the person who used to return from SHO.

takes.text: [dry] दूसरी चाबी, madam। दो साल से किसी के माँगने का इंतज़ार कर रही थी।
takes.transcript: दूस्री चाभी माडम दो साल से किसी के मांगने का अंतजार कर रही ती
takes.transcript_en_pass: Second key, madam. I've been waiting for someone to ask for it for the past two years.

takes.text: [dry] Whoever SHO sahab turned away, I sent across the line, madam.
takes.transcript: Whoever SHO Sahab turned away, I sent across the line, madam.

takes.text: [slowly] Madam. In the evening SHO sahab phoned Bhaiyaji. The call went through. I heard 'talkies'. Then the door shut.
takes.transcript: Madam, in the evening, S.H.O. Sahab phoned Bhaiyaji. The call went through. I heard talkies. Then the door shut.

takes.text: [briskly] कल दस बजे मेरी press conference है, SI Joshi। उससे पहले वो आदमी lockup में चाहिए।
takes.transcript: कल 10 बजे मेरी प्रस्कोंट्रन्स है, एस आई जूची. उस से पहले वो आद्मी लोक अप में चाही है.
takes.transcript_en_pass: Tomorrow is my press conference at 10 am, S.I. Joshi. Before that, that man should be in lock up.
takes.phone_filter_transcript: hi: 'कल 10 बजे मेरी प्रेस् कोंट्रन्स है, एस आईजुशी. उसे पहले वो आद्मी लोकओप में चाही है.' en: 'Tomorrow is my press conference at 10 a.m. Before that, that man should be in the lock-up.'

takes.text: [proudly] और ये रहा नक़ली Inspector: arrest। शाबाश, SI Joshi।
takes.transcript: और ये रहा, नकली इंश्पेक्टा अरेस्ट शाभाश, S.I. Joshi
takes.transcript_en_pass: And here he is, a fake inspector. Arrest. Well done, S.I. Joshi.
takes.phone_filter_transcript: hi: 'और ये रहान नकली इंश्पेक्टर अरेस्ट शाबाश एसाए जोशी' en: 'And here he is, a fake inspector. Arrest. Well done, S.I. Joshi.'

takes.text: [briskly] My press conference is at ten tomorrow, SI Joshi. I want that man in the lockup before it.
takes.transcript: My press conference is at 10 tomorrow, SI Joshi. I want that man in the lock up before it.
takes.phone_filter_transcript: en: 'My press conference is at 10 tomorrow, Esai Joshi. I want that man in the lockup before it.'

takes.text: [curt] No raid happens on something heard over a fake thana's phone, SI Joshi. Put him in the lockup now.
takes.transcript: No raid happens on something heard over a fake Tana's phone. S.I. Joshi, put him in the lock up now.
takes.phone_filter_transcript: en: 'No raid happens on something heard over a fake Tana's phone. S.I. Yoshi, put him in the lock up now.'

takes.text: [tired] असली थाने में एक बार जा चुके हैं, madam।
takes.transcript: अस्ली ताने में एक भर जा जुके है, मैंडम.
takes.transcript_en_pass: I have been to the real police station once, madam.

takes.text: [sighs] अब इतनी रात को किसकी complaint, madam? दरवाज़ा बंद कर लीजिए।
takes.transcript: अब इतने रात को किसकी कुम्प्लेंट माडम दर्वाजा बंग कर लिजे
takes.transcript_en_pass: Now, who's going to complain so late at night? Close the door.

takes.text: [tired] We have been to the real thana once already, madam.
takes.transcript: We have been to the real thana once already madam.

takes.text: [sighs] A complaint, at this hour, madam? Shut the door.
takes.transcript: A complaint at this hour madam? Shut the door!

takes.text: [indignant] निराला जी नक़ली? इन्होंने तो मेरी बकरी ढूँढी थी!
takes.transcript: निराला जी नकली? इनो ने तो मेरी बक्री धूंटी थी.
takes.transcript_en_pass: Nerala's fake? She was looking for my goat.

takes.text: [scolding] इतने भले आदमी को बाँध रखा है?
takes.transcript: इतने बले आदनी को बांद रखा है
takes.transcript_en_pass: It ne bhaale aadmi ko baand rakha hai?

takes.text: [indignant] Nirala ji is fake? He found my goat!
takes.transcript: Nirala Ji is fake? He found my goat.

takes.text: [scolding] You have tied up such a good man?
takes.transcript: You have tied up such a good man?

takes.text: [stubborn] Receipt है मेरे पास। निराला जी की मोहर वाली।
takes.transcript: रिसीट है मेरे पास निदाला जी की मोहर वाली
takes.transcript_en_pass: I have a recipe for Nidala Ji's Mohar Wali.
takes.segment_transcripts: 1.6-3.2 s: small hi 'निदाला जी की मोहर वाली', small en 'Nidala Ji Ki Mohar Wali', base 'Nidhalaji'. 'निराला' heard as 'निदाला' by every pass.

takes.text: [hurt] मोहर असली थी, madam। उनका काम भी असली था।
takes.transcript: महर अस्ली ती मैडम उन्टा काम दी अस्ली ठा
takes.transcript_en_pass: Mohar was real madam. His work was also real.

takes.text: [stubborn] I have a receipt. With Nirala ji's stamp on it.
takes.transcript: I have a receipt with Niralaji's stamp on it.

takes.text: [hurt] The stamp was real, madam. So was his work.
takes.transcript: The stamp was real madam, so was his work.

takes.text: [level] आप चुप रहिए। सवाल गवाह से है।
takes.transcript: आप चुप रही, सवाल गवासे है
takes.transcript_en_pass: You keep quiet. The question is from the witness.

takes.text: [level] बलराम ठाकुर, दयाशंकर त्रिपाठी: आरोप तय, bail ख़ारिज। [pause] सुधीर निराला: bail मंज़ूर।
takes.transcript: बल्राम तागुर देया शंकर त्रपाठी आरोप तै बेल खारज सुदिर निराला बेल मन्जूर
takes.transcript_en_pass: Balram Thakur, Daya Shankar Tripathi. Arop Thai, Bail Kharej. Sudhir Nirala, Bail Manzoor.

takes.text: [level] You will keep quiet. The question is for the witness.
takes.transcript: You will keep quiet. The question is for the witness.

takes.text: [level] Twenty-four envelopes. Not one of them opened?
takes.transcript: 24 envelopes. Not one of them opened?

takes.text: [smoothly] SI Joshi। हाँ या ना। क्या आपको पता था कि ये आदमी police नहीं है?
takes.transcript: सी जोशी हा याना क्या आपको पता था कि ये आद्मी पुलिस नहीं है?
takes.transcript_en_pass: SI Joshi Yes or no? Did you know that this man is not a cop?

takes.text: [amused] 'हाँ' कहिए... तो order के ख़िलाफ़ एक नक़ली police वाले को आपने भेजा।
takes.transcript: तो अड़ के खलाफ एक नकली पूलिस वाले को आपने बेजा.
takes.transcript_en_pass: So you sent a fake police officer against the order?
takes.segment_transcripts: 0-1.35 s: hi 'अग, कहीए!', en 'Ha ha ha, Kahiye!', base en 'Haha! What is this?'. 'हाँ' may be voiced as a laugh.

takes.text: [smoothly] SI Joshi. Yes or no. Did you know this man is not police?
takes.transcript: S.I. Joshi. Yes or no? Did you know this man is not police?

takes.text: [amused] Say 'yes'... and you sent a fake policeman in, against orders.
takes.transcript: Say yes and you send a fake policeman in against orders.

takes.text: [tired] जो ख़ुद हथकड़ी में है, वो हमें क्या बचाएगा, निराला जी?
takes.transcript: जो खुद हतकरी में है, वो हमें क्या बचाएगा निराला जी?
takes.transcript_en_pass: What will we save in our own hands, Ms. Nerala?

takes.text: [sharp] रात के एक बजे register? कल आइए, madam।
takes.transcript: राद के एक बजे रजिस्टर कल आए मार्ँम
takes.transcript_en_pass: 1 o'clock register? Come tomorrow madam.

takes.text: [tired] A man in handcuffs himself, how will he save us, Nirala ji?
takes.transcript: A man in handcuffs himself, how will he save us Nirala ji?

takes.text: [sharp] A register at one in the night? Come tomorrow, madam.
takes.transcript: A register at one in the night? Come tomorrow, madam.

takes.text: [loudly] DSP साहब, chief guest ही आरोपी हैं?
takes.transcript: दीस्पी सहब चीव गेस्ट ही आरोपी है
takes.transcript_en_pass: DSP Sahab, Chief Guest Hi Aaropi Hai.

takes.text: [urgent] DSP साहब, बस एक सवाल! FIR कब लिखी गई?
takes.transcript: दीस्पी सहब बस एक सवार अपने कब लिख ही गई?
takes.transcript_en_pass: DSP Sahab, just one question. When did FIR get written?

takes.text: [loudly] DSP sahab, is the chief guest himself the accused?
takes.transcript: DSP Sahab, is the chief guest himself the accused?

takes.text: [urgent] DSP sahab, just one question! When was the FIR written?
takes.transcript: DSB Sahab, just one question. When was the FIR written?
